card.complexity-sensemaking: What kind of situation is this: clear, complicated, complex or on fire
card.consider-opposite: Consider the opposite: the strongest version of the other view
card.customer-interviews: Ask customers about their past, not about your idea (The Mom Test)
card.demand-test: Test demand before you build — a hypothesis with numbers and the cheapest test (pretotyping)
card.evaporating-cloud: The evaporating cloud — a dilemma without a rotten compromise
card.first-principles: First principles: break it down to the basics and build it anew
card.goal-to-plan: From goal to first steps: the goal, where I am now, the ways, what I will do
card.is-is-not: Is / is not: where the problem is and where it is not
card.issue-tree: Issue tree: split the situation into independent branches
card.jobs-to-be-done: What job is it “hired” to do — the customer's progress and the forces of switching (JTBD)
card.mental-contrasting: Wish, obstacle and an “if — then” plan
card.offer-design: The offer: what a person gets and why they will believe it (Value Equation)
card.opportunity-tree: Opportunity tree, the riskiest assumption and priorities
card.positioning: Positioning: what you are compared with and who you are best for
card.pre-mortem: Pre-mortem — a “post-mortem” of a plan that has not started yet
card.reflective-cycle: Make sense of an experience and revise your own rule
card.scamper: Seven directions to change what exists (SCAMPER)
card.socratic-questioning: Socratic questions: test your own belief
card.traction-channels: Where to get the next customers: channels and cheap tests (Bullseye)
card.unit-economics: Does the money add up: what one customer brings and what they cost (LTV and CAC)
card.value-pricing: A price from the value to the customer (EVC)
card.weighted-matrix: A weighted comparison of options by your own values
card.wrap-decision: A hard decision — widen, reality-test, attain distance, prepare (WRAP)
step_question: Last time you chose a step: “{step}”. How did it go, and is it clearer what to do next? You don't have to answer — just keep writing.
